verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs immediate rebalancing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 89 leads at an average cost of $36.26 per lead — and every single one came from Meta, which produced those leads at an effective $9.40 each. At the same time, Google Ads spent $2,390 this period with zero recorded conversions, meaning that budget produced no measurable return. We are reallocating spend away from Google and toward Meta to reflect where your results are actually coming from. With Meta's lead volume accelerating over the most recent days of this period, next period should show a lower blended cost per lead and higher volume as the budget shift takes effect.

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving — 107 opportunities created this period — but no appointments or closed opportunities are showing in the pipeline, meaning leads are stalling after intake.
watch_item.fix: The CRM build completed today (July 31); we are reviewing the intake-to-appointment flow this week to identify and clear the stall point.
